name: @zedec/zxv-web
description: ZXV in the browser: the WebAssembly build of @zedec/zxv in a Web Worker, a typed exact message protocol ("num/den" rationals, decimal-string integers, no floats), explicit capability handles, AbortSignal cancellation, and a SHA3-256-keyed offline cache for the wasm and model files.
author: Michael Laurence Curzi and 36N9 Genetics, LLC

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/sha3.test.js dist/test/wire.test.js dist/test/cache.test.js dist/test/worker.test.js
